units.note: [πρεσβύτου] before Μάγωνος is bracketed by the editor; omission in English is correct.

findings.quote: Hannibal could say nothing against the daring and practical force of the proposal
findings.problem: The Greek marks a gap after Monomachus' proposal (συνήθεις. ... Ἀννίβας δὲ πρὸς μὲν τὸ τόλμημα); the English runs straight on as if continuous.
findings.proposed_fix: [...] Hannibal could say nothing against the daring and practical force of the proposal

units.note: οὐχ ἧττον δὲ καὶ τῶν περιστάσεων = 'and no less of circumstances'; current 'as well' is weaker but not inverted, so not flagged.

findings.quote: these men had divided their operations between themselves in a very grand fashion, and although
findings.problem: γενναιότατα κεκοινωνηκότας ἑαυτοῖς πραγμάτων = 'had been partners with each other in affairs most loyally'. κοινωνέω means to share or be partners, not to divide. 'Divided' cancels the contrast the Greek draws: they had been partners since youth, yet they never took part in the same operation.
findings.proposed_fix: these men had been partners in affairs with each other most loyally, and although

findings.quote: And I heard it even more precisely from Masannasus, who
findings.problem: The Greek has a gap marker after Μασαννάσου (Μασαννάσου... ἀκριβέστερον διήκουσα); the English reads on as though the text were whole. The sense still holds, so this may be a minor gap only.
findings.proposed_fix: And I heard it even more precisely from Masannasus [...], who
